verses.text: For di second year of Darius di king, for di sixth month, for di first day of di month, di Lord word come through Haggai di prophet to Zerubbabel, di pikin of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and to Joshua, di pikin of Jehozadak, di high priest, and e talk say,
Di Lord of Armies talk say, “Dis people dey talk say, ‘Di time never reach, di time for di Lord house to build.’”
Den di Lord word come through Haggai di prophet, and e talk say,
“E be time for una own selves to live inside una paneled houses, while dis house dey lie waste?”
So now, di Lord of Armies talk say, “Consider una ways.”

“Una don sow plenty, but una dey bring in small. Una dey eat, but una no get enough. Una dey drink, but una no dey full with drink. Una dey put on cloth, but nobody dey warm. Di one wey dey earn wages dey earn wages to put am inside bag wey get holes.”
Di Lord of Armies talk say, “Consider una ways.”
“Go up to di mountain, bring wood, and build di house; and I go dey pleased with am, and I go dey glorified,” na so di Lord talk.

“Una look for plenty, and look, e come to small; and when una bring am home, I blow am away. Why?” na so di Lord of Armies talk. “Because of my house wey dey lie waste, while each one of una dey busy with im own house.”
“So because of una, di heavens dey hold back di dew, and di earth dey hold back im fruit.”
“I call for drought on di land, on di mountains, on di grain, on di new wine, on di oil, on wetin di ground dey produce, on men, on livestock, and on all di labor of di hands.”

Den Zerubbabel, di pikin of Shealtiel, and Joshua, di pikin of Jehozadak, di high priest, with all di remnant of di people, obey di voice of di Lord dem God, and di words of Haggai di prophet, as di Lord dem God send am; and di people fear before di Lord.
Den Haggai, di Lord messenger, deliver di Lord message to di people, and talk say, “I dey with una,” na so di Lord talk.

Di Lord stir up di spirit of Zerubbabel, di pikin of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and di spirit of Joshua, di pikin of Jehozadak, di high priest, and di spirit of all di remnant of di people; and dem come and work for di house of di Lord of Armies, dem God,
For di 24th day of di month, for di sixth month, for di second year of Darius di king.
For di seventh month, for di 21st day of di month, di Lord word come through Haggai di prophet, and e talk say,
“Talk now to Zerubbabel, di pikin of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and to Joshua, di pikin of Jehozadak, di high priest, and to di remnant of di people, and say,”
“‘Who among una remain wey see dis house for im former glory? How una dey see am now? E no be like nothing for una eyes if una compare am?’”

“‘Yet now dey strong, Zerubbabel,’ na so di Lord talk; ‘and dey strong, Joshua, pikin of Jehozadak, di high priest; and dey strong, all una people of di land,’ na so di Lord talk, ‘and work, because I dey with una,’ na so di Lord of Armies talk.”
“‘Dis na di word wey I covenant with una when una come out from Egypt, and my Spirit dey live among una. No fear.’”
“Because di Lord of Armies talk say, ‘Once more, small time remain, and I go shake di heavens, di earth, di sea, and di dry land;’”
“‘And I go shake all nations; and di desirable things of all nations go come; and I go fill dis house with glory,’ na so di Lord of Armies talk.”
“‘Di silver na my own, and di gold na my own,’ na so di Lord of Armies talk.”
“‘Di latter glory of dis house go dey greater pass di former,’ na so di Lord of Armies talk; ‘and for dis place I go give peace,’ na so di Lord of Armies talk.”
For di 24th day of di ninth month, for di second year of Darius, di Lord word come through Haggai di prophet, and e talk say,
“Di Lord of Armies talk say, ‘Ask di priests now about di law, and say,’”
“‘If person carry holy meat for di fold of im garment, and with im fold touch bread, or stew, or wine, or oil, or any food, e go become holy?’” Di priests answer, “No.”
Den Haggai talk say, “If one wey dey unclean because of dead body touch any of dem, e go dey unclean?” Di priests answer, “E go dey unclean.”
Den Haggai answer, “‘Na so dis people be, and na so dis nation be before me,’ na so di Lord talk; ‘and na so every work of dem hands be; and wetin dem offer for dat place dey unclean.’”
“‘Now, I beg una, consider from dis day and backward, before dem lay stone on stone for di Lord temple.’”
“‘Through all dat time, when one come to heap of 20 measures, na only ten dey; when one come to di wine vat to draw out 50, na only 20 dey.’”
“‘I strike una with blight and with mildew and with hail for all di work of una hands; yet una no turn to me,’ na so di Lord talk.”
“‘Consider, I beg una, from dis day and backward, from di 24th day of di ninth month, since di day wey dem lay di foundation of di Lord temple, consider am.’”
“‘Di seed still dey inside di barn? Yes, di vine, di fig tree, di pomegranate, and di olive tree never produce. From dis day I go bless una.’”
Di Lord word come di second time to Haggai for di 24th day of di month, and e talk say,
“Talk to Zerubbabel, governor of Judah, and say, ‘I go shake di heavens and di earth.’”

“‘I go overthrow di throne of kingdoms. I go destroy di strength of di kingdoms of di nations. I go overthrow di chariots and dem wey ride inside dem. Di horses and dem riders go come down, everyone by di sword of im brother.’”

“‘For dat day,’ na so di Lord of Armies talk, ‘I go take you, Zerubbabel my servant, di pikin of Shealtiel,’ na so di Lord talk, ‘and I go make you like signet; because I don choose you,’ na so di Lord of Armies talk.”
